about: I'm a full-stack developer based in Alicante, Spain, currently working at NTT DATA. I build and maintain business tools for employees using Angular, Spring Boot and Java, and I also write technical documentation for our projects.

I like projects where the backend and the frontend are designed together, not separately. My most recent personal project, similart, is a real-time multiplayer drawing game built with Angular, Express and Socket.IO — the same stack that powers this site.

cv.summary: Full-stack developer with professional experience at NTT DATA, working with Angular, Spring Boot and Java. I have a Higher Vocational Training Certificate in Web Application Development, and I also build personal full-stack projects like similart, a real-time multiplayer game. I enjoy working on both backend and frontend, and I am always learning new technologies.

skills.backend: Node.js, Express, Socket.IO, Spring Boot, Java

projects.title: Similart
projects.problem: I wanted to build a project with real-time features, image processing, and a game that is easy to explain but fun to build.
projects.role: I designed and developed the full project alone: the three backend services, the real-time logic, and the drawing interface in Angular.
projects.outcome: The game works from start to end for 1 to 12 players, with reconnection, an admin panel, and a voting phase with a real countdown.
projects.cvBullet: Real-time multiplayer drawing game with % similarity score, for 1 to 12 players. Built with Angular, Express, Socket.IO and PostgreSQL.

projects.title: This portfolio
projects.problem: I wanted a portfolio that helps me get interviews, not just a website that looks nice. Most developer portfolios are not built with that goal.
projects.role: I planned everything before writing any code: I researched what recruiters really look at, and I wrote down every performance decision from day one.
projects.outcome: A 100% static website (Angular and JSON only, no backend or database), pre-rendered and hosted on GitHub Pages. It works as a technical roadmap I can share, with a clear reason behind every decision.
